this_accession_role: GSE312393 = human bulk RNA-seq of exercised vs resting vastus lateralis (24 h after eccentric downhill running) and pre vs post 6-week resistance training (S5.1.3.p1, S5.2.26.p1)
sample_inclusion: 3 young healthy males 24 h after 40 min downhill running (-15%, 60% VO2max) and 3 healthy males at rest; no previous training (S5.1.3.p1; FIG6 legend J: n=3 exercised, n=3 control)
primary_estimand: Expression change in human vastus lateralis 24 h after an acute eccentric exercise bout vs resting muscle (between-subject), focused on BMP-pathway genes and RFLNA (S2.5.p5, FIG6 J)
planned_contrasts: 24h exercise vs rest control (S2.5.p5, FIG6 J; paper reports a heatmap of selected genes only, no DEG count)
normalization: tximport counts, DESeq2 variance-stabilizing transformation, gene-scaled for heatmaps (S5.2.27.p1)
paper_method: No differential-expression test reported for the human exercise bulk data; DESeq2 VST values shown as heatmaps (S5.2.27.p1, FIG6 J)

paper_threshold.source_locator: S5.2.27.p1; S5.3.p1 states padj<0.05 & |log2FC|>0.15 & >=5% cells only for sc/snRNA-seq

paper_results: Upregulation of BMP1, BMPR2 and RFLNA (aSC2 marker homolog) 24 h after the bout (S2.5.p5)
